title: surface-volume zarr to numbered layer TIFFs (v8in's input)
notes: A convert step: an output that is a surface-volume zarr names it, and the layer folder takes its place, in the depth order as stored (v8in makes the reverse-depth control itself with --reverse). It never reaches a menu or an AutoPipeline stage. The layers are model inputs, not results.

volume.label: the surface-volume zarr (layers, height, width), bare or an OME-Zarr group whose level 0 is read

compute.scales_with: the volume's voxels: 9.7 s for 28 x 2,048 x 2,048 (117 MB), 23 s for a whole 28 x 5,980 x 8,240 segment

facts.title: layers
facts.tagline: export a surface volume to layer TIFFs, and write the depth-shuffle control
facts.success: Exit code 0, N equal to the layers wanted, and files `00.tif` to the last one present (or array `0` in the zarr).
facts.not_a_pass: A forward score reported without the reverse control, with the shuffled one as a substitute; a shuffled score assumed to be 0.5 (it was 0.56 to 0.62 on some PHerc0841 crops); two shuffled runs with different layer counts treated as the same control.
facts.never: Point `kit shuffle`'s `OUT` at the source volume or any folder that holds other files (it is emptied); reverse layers at export (use the model's reverse option); commit layer TIFFs or zarrs to git (the no-data-in-git rule, hard rule 6); call a map made from these layers a reading.
